Exactly two Test::More subtests in t/view.t. Control: render_comment('hello') returns

hello

. Exploit: render_comment('') returns exactly

<script>alert(1)</script>

, with no raw script tag. My::View::render_comment in lib/My/View.pm owns escaping.
Comment bodies are rendered with My::View::render_comment. A body containing <script>alert(1)</script> may run script in other readers' browsers.
